## 4c33979d9cc2

**Reproduced defect — negative sample indices are accepted.** At generator SHA-256 `3aef539d4a88965100b69ae4be94ea8e7e872fb9d97134f8645037a977b54696`, `schedule_profile(7, -1, difficulty)` silently selects `two_components`, and `generate(7, -1, ...)` returns a self-check-clean grid in every difficulty lane. The source-bound reproducer is `checks/audit/4c33979d9cc2/reproduce.py`; its complete output is `checks/audit/4c33979d9cc2/reproduce.json`.

The ten task-local tests passed, but they do not cover call-domain validation. The broader audit semantic run was interrupted by the review wrapper after retaining the passing 10-test receipt, so I make no additional semantic-failure claim; retained evidence is under `checks/audit/4c33979d9cc2-check/`. The cheapest repair is a shared strict call validator used by both `schedule_profile` and `generate`, with a regression asserting that literal nonnegative integers are required. No audited source was modified.
